units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:8">Bets. I, 8</cite> <he>בורר א׳ ואוֹכֵל</he> (Y. ed. <he>בורר אוכל אוכל</he>) he selects singly what is edible and eats immediately; a. fr.—<he>א׳ נפש</he> the necessary food for the day.
Meg. I, 5 אלא א׳ נ׳ בלבד except the preparation of food (cooking &c., permitted on Holy Days, Ex. XII, 16).—Pl. אוֹכְלִים, אוֹכְלִין food, eatables.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 52b:1">Ab. Zar. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>תקרובת ע״ז של א׳</he> an idolatrous offering consisting of edibles; Y. ib. IV, 43ᵈ <he>אֹכְ׳</he>.
